title: bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain: (4,3) Q(zeta_15) CM-STNFS, Zero-Gap H5-Mean Internal-Retry M1 (p_bar=2%, K=6, mu>=20) & ZERO-EA Det-2592 Boot, E[W_G1] < 2^113.052349273957 G1 units

claims.statement: For BLS12-381 plain G1 ECDLP (bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain), on any supplied T = [x]P0 in G1 (uniform x in 0..r-1, including T = infinity for x = 0, with no auxiliary powers), under explicitly declared exploratory-v1 STNFS premises (H1, H2, H3, H-R, H-SM, H-X, and Zero-Gap Telescoping Internal-Retry H5-Mean requiring only a single scalar mean effective single-trial empty rate E[p_eff(Q) | Q reached] <= p_bar = 0.02 at modeled mu_1 >= 20.15 across K=6 fresh i.i.d. WITH-REPLACEMENT known-log f-ideals p_j in [2^12, 2^14) behind a 4.0x pointwise survivor cap and deterministic single-factor ECM, with NO good/bad ideal split and exact telescoping child-work bound cW/(1-cPhi); ZERO H-EA and ZERO boot-norm distribution premise via ZERO-EA deterministic Lovasz M_boot = 2592.0 with surv_b = 1.0), the self-contained (4,3) Q(zeta_15) CM-STNFS algorithm transfers (P0, T) to G_T via the public pairing e(., Q0) and recovers the 64-hex scalar x with [x]P0 = T with cold-run success probability >= 0.39 and expected total classical work E[W_G1] <= 1 + (K/2^64)*10*(2^111.0885 + 2^66) < 2^113.052349273957 G1 units (C = 2,000 baseline scalar ARMv8.0-A integer instructions; core rows in C_core = 20,000 = 10 G1 units, core 2^109.730421179070, unified aborting meter t_run = 2^123 core units giving deterministic pointwise cap < 2^126.3219282 G1 units).
